title: CompTIA CySA+ (CS0-004)
subtitle: Trening za CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst V4 (CS0-004, od 23. 6. 2026): sigurnosne operacije, upravljanje ranjivostima, odgovor na incidente i izvještavanje, sa PBQ pitanjima i labovima za skeniranje, prioritizaciju ranjivosti (CVSS, EPSS, KEV), analizu mrežnog saobraćaja i metrike.
subtitle_en: Training for CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst V4 (CS0-004, from June 23, 2026): security operations, vulnerability management, incident response and reporting, with PBQs and labs for scanning, vulnerability prioritization (CVSS, EPSS, KEV), network traffic analysis and metrics.

exam.note: Pravi CS0-004 ima najviše 85 pitanja (višestruki izbor i performance-based pitanja), 165 minuta, prolaz 750 na skali 100–900. Certifikat važi 3 godine (CE program).
exam.note_en: The real CS0-004 has a maximum of 85 questions (multiple-choice and performance-based questions), 165 minutes, and a passing score of 750 on a 100–900 scale. The certification is valid for 3 years (CE program).

objectives.en: Explain system and network architecture concepts in security operations
objectives.bs: Arhitektura sistema i mreže u sigurnosnim operacijama

objectives.en: Analyze indicators of potential malicious activity
Use tools to determine malicious activity
Explain threat intelligence and threat-hunting concepts
Describe efficiency and process improvement in security operations
objectives.bs: Efikasnost i unapređenje procesa u sigurnosnim operacijama

objectives.en: Summarize concepts related to the use of AI in security operations
Implement the appropriate vulnerability scanning method
Analyze output from vulnerability assessment tools
objectives.bs: Analiza izlaza alata za procjenu ranjivosti

objectives.en: Explain concepts related to control types, risks, and vulnerability management
objectives.bs: Tipovi kontrola, rizik i upravljanje ranjivostima

objectives.en: Summarize concepts related to attack methodology frameworks
Explain vulnerability management reporting and communication
Describe security operations, incident response reporting, and communication
objectives.bs: Izvještavanje i komunikacija o sigurnosnim operacijama i incidentima
